findings.statement: CA9 is up-regulated in tumor at RNA (log2FC 6.312, padj 1.72e-49) and protein (log2FC 2.269, padj 9.9e-43); it replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and survives purity extrapolation (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 7.787). Girentuximab reached PHASE_3.

SCARB1 is the top-ranked gene in the target profile (score 4.1314): RNA log2FC 2.974 and protein log2FC 1.837 up in tumor, TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.989 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.762, indicating tumor-intrinsic expression. It has no DepMap dependency (mean effect 0.002) and no prognostic signal (Cox padj 0.684).

CD70 is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 7.09) and remains high at purity 1 (4.278). It is an antibody-drug target with agents such as cusatuzumab (PHASE_2) and vorsetuzumab mafodotin (PHASE_1).

ENPP3 is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 5.557 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 5.278. The antibody-drug conjugate AGS-16C3F reached PHASE_2, and copy-number loss frequency is 0.182.

NNMT is strongly up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 4.67) and protein (log2FC 2.709). It replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 4.685) and higher expression is associated with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479). It ranks 4th in the target profile and 6th in the biomarker profile.

SLC16A3 (MCT4) is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.291 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.821. It has a positive CNV-to-RNA cis effect (rho 0.258) and no drugs yet.

HK2 is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 3.351) and protein (log2FC 2.106). It replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 3.974) and shows tumor-intrinsic expression (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.989). The DepMap mean effect in ccRCC is -0.123, so there is no strong selective dependency.

PSAT1 is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963), tops the biomarker profile (score 5.3696), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -2.974), and its expression associates with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.43, padj 5.66e-7).

ALDH6A1 is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -3.399) and protein (log2FC -1.925); the CNV loss frequency is 0.355 with a positive cis effect (rho 0.525), consistent with a 3p-linked dosage effect. Higher expression is protective (TCGA Cox log HR -0.554, padj 9.45e-12). This loss of tubule identity makes it a biomarker rather than a target.

PCK1 is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -4.424) and protein (log2FC -1.859), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -3.079), and higher expression associates with better survival (Cox log HR -0.415, padj 1.91e-7). This reflects loss of proximal tubule gluconeogenic identity.

SLC6A19 is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -4.574) and protein (log2FC -1.48), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -3.221), and higher expression associates with better survival (Cox log HR -0.456, padj 1.07e-7). It is a proximal tubule marker lost in ccRCC.
VHL loses a copy in 0.791 of tumors (3p) and is mutated in 247 of 511 patients (frequency 0.483, padj 0.0), which explains the HIF-driven program (CA9, ANGPTL4, NNMT).
PBRM1 is recurrently mutated in 185 of 511 patients (frequency 0.362, padj 4.59e-239), making it the second major driver after VHL on 3p.

caveats: Tumor-up targets show no selective DepMap dependency in ccRCC lines (mean effects near 0), so target status rests on expression, tractability and tumor-intrinsic signal rather than essentiality.
Protein log2FC (TMT) is compressed relative to RNA log2FC, so magnitudes across layers are not directly comparable.
Down-regulated genes mostly reflect loss of normal tubule identity, so they are biomarker candidates and not therapeutic targets.

Only 9 convergence genes were queried in depth; I did not run phosphosite or kinase analyses for this output. The convergence_ranking(n=40) output was saved to a file and I used the target and biomarker profile rows.
